name: Koyome
taglineZh: 歡迎——就把這裡當成自己的家。
intro:
Koyome here — this is my own small corner of the internet.

If you are interested in learning about my life, my feelings, and my thoughts, I have put them all here. The items here are not yet complete, and I will do my best to optimize and improve them. If there are any inconveniences, please accept my apologies. 

Have a look around — stay as long as you like.
introZh:
我是 Koyome，這裡是我在網路上的一小塊地。

如果您有興趣了解，關於我的生活我的感受我的想法，我都放在這裡了。這裡的東西都還沒完成，我會盡力優化和改善，如有不便請多見諒（左上角切换语言）。

隨便逛吧——想待多久都可以。
armNoteZh:
你观测世界，我观测你
无限远点的牵牛星
